philosophy.heading: Why we don't sell predefined packages
philosophy.intro: "Starter / Growth / Scale" packages are convenient for agencies, but rarely a good fit for clients. The reality is that:
bullets: A local coffee shop with 300 Instagram followers does not need "Performance Max + Email Marketing + Influencer outreach" — it needs a single hyper-targeted Meta campaign plus solid content production
An e-commerce store with steady traffic and a good AOV does not need "rebranding + social media strategy + landing page redesign" — it just needs Meta scaling + Google Shopping optimization
A B2B SaaS with a long sales cycle does not need "volume campaigns" — it needs LinkedIn Ads + retargeting + content marketing
philosophy.outro: Standardized packages force clients to buy what they don't need. We choose the opposite: we recommend only what works for your specific context.

items.question: What is the minimum budget to work with you?
items.answer: We do not publish prices because every situation is different — a coffee shop that wants its first 50 clients a month needs a different investment than a brand that wants to enter a region. Before "how much does it cost," we ask: what do you sell, who do you sell to, what have you tried, what works, where do you want to be. The budget comes out of the answers. If what you want to achieve does not match what you can invest, we tell you directly — we do not take your money for a campaign that cannot deliver results.

items.question: How long until I get my website?
items.answer: Conversion landing page: 7-14 business days after we receive the content. Complete website (5-8 pages, blog, integrations): 3-5 weeks. Custom e-commerce or dedicated plugin: 4-8 weeks. The actual timeframe depends on how fast you give feedback. We work in weekly iterations — you get a prototype, you give feedback, we adjust. Without an involved client, no website is finished on time.

items.question: What is the workflow for working together?
items.answer: In 5 steps: 1. Discovery call (30 min, free). 2. Audit (3-5 days, free if we work together afterwards). 3. Strategic proposal (5-7 days). 4. Implementation (variable duration, weekly milestones). 5. Optimization & reporting (a monthly report with analysis, NOT an auto dashboard). You pay when and if you sign the contract.

items.question: Why don't you charge a monthly maintenance fee for websites?
items.answer: Because fixed maintenance subscriptions are most often wasted money. A well-built website on a modern stack does not need "monthly maintenance" — it does not break by itself. We work differently: the website is delivered functional, secured, documented. When you need changes, we charge only for the actual work. You pay for what you get, not a permanent subscription.

items.question: What are the hidden costs of a website?
items.answer: There are none when working with us — you get a quote with everything included in the price, clear line by line. In general, watch out for: unsuitable hosting (200-500 RON/month retail vs ~25 EUR/month professional), a domain hidden under the developer (check it is in your name), premium plugins paid annually (60-300 EUR/year each), small changes that add up to hundreds of euros without a clear structure, paid SSL (it is free from Let's Encrypt — if someone asks you for 200 RON/year, run).

items.question: Can I work with you if I already run campaigns on another account?
items.answer: Yes. In fact, that is the ideal situation — we have a real starting point. The process: 1. "Analyst" access (read-only) to Meta/Google/TikTok accounts. 2. A 3-5 day audit (free if we work together afterwards). 3. You decide whether to transfer management or whether we work in a complementary way. We do NOT trash-talk previous work. Sometimes it is good, sometimes it is not. We tell you honestly what we see.

items.question: If results don't show in the first few weeks, is something wrong?
items.answer: Not necessarily — and it is exactly the kind of question that should be asked honestly before we sign. The Meta and Google algorithms need at least 14-21 days to exit the learning phase. In the first 4 weeks we evaluate whether the direction is correct (cost per lead decreasing, lead quality increasing). Real optimization comes in months 2-3. The only situation in which we tell you honestly "we are not on the right track": the numbers are FAR below the benchmarks and we do not see how to recover. In that case we prefer to break the contract rather than burn through your budget.

about.subHeadline: I'm Laurentiu, founder of Green Pheonix Concept. I work at the intersection of data, design and execution — no jargon, no fluff, just measurable results.

section1.title: Why Green Pheonix exists
section1.p1: I've been working in marketing since 2024. I started as a Marketing Specialist at The Family Butchers România, running Meta campaigns for two national FMCG brands — Reinert and Martinel. In that time I gained hands-on experience across more than 1.1 million impressions and 700,000 people reached through multi-platform campaigns.
section1.p2: But I also saw what doesn't work in this industry. Agencies selling buzzwords. Flashy websites that don't sell. Beautiful ads made by agencies that don't perform because Meta's algorithms flag them as “advertising” and penalize them. Clients treated as IDs in a dashboard.
section1.p3: Green Pheonix grew out of one conviction: performance marketing should be done differently. We think before we act, we measure before we optimize, and we're honest with clients — even when they don't want to hear it.

section2.title: The four things I fundamentally believe

belief1.title: Simplicity that sells > decorative complexity
belief1.body: A beautiful site that doesn't sell is just an expensive suit. I build sites that are clear, fast, with a single path to action. Design isn't a creative award — it's a mechanism for trust and conversion. The most effective sites I've built are also the simplest.

belief2.title: Ads alone don't sell
belief2.body: A good ad moves traffic. Your organic profile decides whether they buy. Before the first campaign, I look at what a user finds when they reach you: is the social profile active? Are there real reviews? Is the content authentic or does it look like stock? The organic foundation is the investment that multiplies the ROI of every ad that follows.

belief3.title: Authenticity matters to clients and to algorithms
belief3.body: In 2026, ads that look like ads die. Meta rolled out Andromeda — an ML system that favors creative that looks REAL: UGC, natural lifestyle, people talking about a product instead of “selling” it. One person who steps in front of the camera and builds a connection with the brand is worth more than 10 glossy agency videos. For consumers and for algorithms alike.

belief4.title: Strategy before execution
belief4.body: Good campaigns are thought through, not improvised. Before the first ad: who is the ideal client, what message resonates, what objection needs dismantling, what path they take from click to purchase. That's the difference between an “agency that pushes buttons” and an “agency that produces results”. I turn down contracts where the client wants to skip strategy. Not because I can't — because I've seen too many campaigns burned on sloppy execution.

section3.title: How I work
section3.p1: You work directly with me. There's no intermediary account manager handing you off to a developer. You talk to me — I execute.
section3.p2: I work with a small number of clients, not a portfolio of 30. I'd rather have 4-6 serious clients handled with care than 30 handled superficially.
section3.p3: We communicate on your preferred channel — Slack, WhatsApp, email. I reply within 24 working hours. For real emergencies (a campaign down, a site crashed), I reply faster.
section3.p4: I work in three languages: Romanian, Italian, English. That opens up opportunities for clients who want to reach the Romanian diaspora in Italy or the UK.

process.h1: How we work. 5 steps, no surprises.
process.subHeadline: Our process is not website decoration. It is the mechanism that lets us turn down the wrong projects and deliver properly on the ones we accept.

intro.heading: Why we have a strict process
intro.p1: Most agencies start execution in week 1 after signing. We start thinking in week 1. It is a fundamental difference.
intro.p2: A solid process protects you from two real risks:
risks: Paying for execution on the wrong strategy (campaigns that do not work for your product, a beautiful website that does not sell)
Being unable to measure what happened (tracking was not planned from the start, undefined KPIs, you do not know what to optimize)
intro.p3: Our process solves both problems. It is not bureaucracy — it is discipline that pays off.

steps.heading: We listen before we recommend
steps.body: The first contact is a simple conversation, not a sales pitch. We ask you: What have you built so far? Where do you want to be in 6-12 months? What have you tried? What worked, what did not? What budget, timeline and team do you have? We tell you whether we are a good fit or not. If we are not, we recommend who to look for. If we are, we move on to step 2.
deliver: An honest conversation with no pitch
A clear recommendation: we are a fit / we are not a fit
A follow-up email with a summary

steps.heading: We analyze what is there, we do not assume
steps.cost: Free if we work together afterwards
steps.body: Before any proposal, we look carefully at your entire digital ecosystem. We assume NOTHING. We analyze: Website (performance, UX, SEO, conversion), existing ad accounts (campaigns, audiences, creative, tracking), organic presence (social media, Google My Business, reviews), direct competition (3-5 competitors), tracking (pixels, conversions, attribution).
deliver: A 10-20 page audit document with concrete findings
A prioritized list of issues (high impact / low effort first)
3-5 tactical recommendations you can implement yourself
Note: the audit is separate from the proposal. If we do not work together, you keep the document.

steps.heading: A concrete plan, not poetry
steps.body: Based on the audit, we build a tailored plan. We do NOT use generic templates. It contains: measurable objectives over 3-6 months (concrete numbers), strategy (which channels, in what order, with what reasoning), KPIs for each channel, detailed deliverables by milestone, a realistic timeline, a clear line-by-line budget, an ROI decision point.
deliver: We negotiate honestly where discrepancies appear
You pay when and if you sign. The proposal remains yours regardless of your decision.

steps.heading: Execution by milestone, no surprises
steps.body: This is where you see whether the agency can deliver. We work transparently — you see what we do in real time. How we work day to day: communication channel of your choice (Slack/WhatsApp/email), response within 24h on business days, weekly milestones, continuous access to accounts (Editor role), live documentation (shared Notion).

steps.heading: We report what matters, not what looks good
steps.body: Our reporting is not an auto dashboard. It is a personal analysis with context and recommendations. What you get monthly: raw numbers (relevant metrics, not vanity), trends (month-over-month), the story (what happened, why, what it means), wins and losses (honesty), recommendations (3-5 concrete actions for next month).
deliver: A written report by the 5th of the month
A quarterly review with a strategy reset if necessary

cta.heading: Ready to start with step 1?
cta.body: A 30-minute discovery call. No pitch, no pressure. Just an honest conversation about what you are trying to build.
